items: 【RAM & Storage】This computer comes with 8GB RAM DDR5 | 512GB SSD

【Intel Core 5 120U Processor】It is a mid-range notebook CPU based on the Raptor Lake-U Refresh (RPL-U) series , which was introduced in January 2024. The CPU offers 2 performance cores (P-cores, Golden Cove architecture) and 8 efficiency cores (E-cores, Gracemont architecture). The P-cores support hyperthreading (therefore 12 threads together) and clock from 1.4 to 5 GHz. The E-cores clock from 0.9 - 3.8 GHz and should offer comparable performance to old Skylake cores (e.g. i7-6300HQ).

【14-inch 2K Touch Display】Intuitive touchscreen technology lets you control your PC right from the screen. Transform your content with 1920 x 1200 resolution and 178-degree wide-viewing angles. Make taking notes, sketching, and editing easier by rotating the screen to tablet or tent mode. Multitouch-enabled, IPS (in-plane switching), edge-to-edge glass.
【Other features】Intel Graphics,Microsoft Copilot,Tuned stereo speakers,HP Audio Boost,HP 5MP IR Camera with HDR Switch,Windows 11 Home OS.

【Bundle with Capacitive Stylus with Magnetic Cap】Stylus pen is made of aluminum alloy, which is light weight and very comfortable to hold, and it does not need to connect Bluetooth and does not need to be charged. The cap is magnetic and can absorb in the end of stylus pens.
